svg.aria-label: The diagnose skill run by a person: /diagnose <symptom>. Boxes: The diagnosis record opened, the symptom quoted, the place of the probes named (a step of the session); The red command: red on the exact symptom, three runs in a row, then tightened (a step of the session); No red command (stop); A red command a person drives (stop); Not enough output after redaction (stop); The case shrunk until each remaining part is needed for the red (a step of the session); Three to five ranked hypotheses, each with the result that would falsify it (a step of the session); The hypotheses (stop); A probe: one change for one hypothesis, the red command run, the change undone (a step of the session); The cause at its operation, every place of the defect and the other inputs (a step of the session); The cause not found (stop); The test red without the fix, then the fix at every place and every run green (a step of the session); The record shown, the scratch copy removed, the cause in the commit message (a step of the session).
